Original logo as supplied. Editable HTML text, fixed1080x1920, all content within60px safe margins. No fabricated Quran or UI. Style must be visibly different from green first collection, coordinated with other direction02 posters.

Replace rejected cobalt/peach circular editorial composition with a premium cinematic app-store poster. Fixed1080x1920. Charcoal #171A1D and warm white #FAF6F0, restrained burnished copper #C68B62. No blue, purple, peach disks, arches, chapter numbers or decorative shapes. Sophisticated tangible matte charcoal material, subtle directional light. Original logo top-right small in brandrow. Large beautifully set bold Arabic Noto Naskh headline white, right-aligned at x90 y160 width900, two lines EXACT: رفيقك اليومي / مع القرآن. Exact support below: قراءة وحفظ وورد يومي في تجربة واحدة. Phone bottom within1880. Warm narrow copper light behind phone edges, dark typography field. Refined large typography, clear hierarchy and optical spacing, high contrast, no crowded decorations.
